breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains W2 = 100 m/s at β2 = 30° (giving Va ≈ 86.6 m/s) while simultaneously asserting Va is constant at W1·cos(β1) ≈ 106 m/s. This directly repeats the original inconsistency. The ground truth resolves this by recalculating W2 = Va/cos(β2) ≈ 122.5 m/s, which the generated specification fails to do.
